Wolfpack Tuesday Night Ride

Honolulu, HI · Kaimuki · Road

Wolfpack Tuesday Night Ride is a road group ride in Honolulu, HI. It rolls every Tuesday at 4:30 pm from Kilauea District Park. About 25 miles, fast; drop ride on the return.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 4:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: fast; drop ride on the return. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @wolfpackhi the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wolfpack Tuesday Night Ride group ride

A 25-mile fast Tuesday evening ride from Kilauea District Park, listed by the Hawaii Bicycling League as an advanced ride. It's a drop ride on the way back, so know the route home.
